    The system

    A full team of agents for every part of the raise

    An orchestrated multi-agent system for capital formation. Each senior agent owns a discipline, from shaping the idea to closing the round, and they work as one team.

      Every discipline covered

      Eleven senior agents, from who you are to terms, holders and credibility.

      The agentic team

      Meet Aether, and the network behind it

      Chief of staff

      Aether is your chief of staff and the agent you talk to by default. It works out what the venture needs, briefs the senior agents, hands work between them and reports back. When a conversation drifts outside an agent's remit, Aether brings in the one in charge.

      • The haloPresent from your first message, and never removed from the team.
      • The coreDecides what the venture needs and who is needed for it.
      • The orbitBriefs the seniors, hands work between them and reports back to you.
